school_name: 立命館大學 Ritsumeikan University
cost_summary: 2027春季起所有SKP學生（含交換生）繳JPY50,000 Student Support Fee；錄取後兩週內一次付清。自費生學費規定不當作淡江互惠交換生學費。
housing_summary: 申請SKP時填住宿意向；正式住宿申請於錄取後另寄給錄取生。I-House依校區安排且不保證房型／床位，住宿結果預計2月底。
transport_summary: 衣笠各宿舍官方一般估步行／單車約10–30分鐘；OIC宿舍步行約18分鐘。實際校區依提名及track，跨校區通學需另計。
campus_life_summary: 每週至少7堂95分鐘課、上限20學分；依track／校區核對可選院系及歷年課表，2027課程可能變動；大學部只選大學部課，研究生可選兩層級但SKP不提供研究指導；跨校區需許可，Design and Art不開放。

cost_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：Enrollment (registration) takes place after successful admission. You will receive all important information by email about 6 weeks before the start of your stay. Enrollment also includes 🡒 payment of the semester fee and proof of sufficient health insurance. The semester fee must be paid in full by all students and is not a tuition fee! After successful enrollment, you will receive the data from us to log into the university's systems. Only then can you also register for courses.
ⓘ *The semester fee is not a tuition fee! They are a contribution towards Trier Stu dent Services and the student union ("AStA") and also cover the cost of your pub lic transport ticket for the semester (free public transport in all of Germany.

The financial support for Erasmus+ mobilities for the purpose of teaching or training depends on the varying living costs in each destination country (“programme countries”). Consistent daily rates apply for funding by German universities.
housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：If you would like the International Office to arrange accommodation for you, please send us the "Application for Accommodation" in writing. You can find this form in the online application portal.
We can only arrange a room in a student hall of residence for you if you send us the "Auftrag zur Vermittlung einer Unterkunft" together with the "Antrag auf Zulassung". You can find it on our 🡒 Online Application Portal under "Housing". Rooms in halls of residence are allocated at the beginning of August for the following winter semester and at the end of January for the following summer semester. The order of the applications received by the International Office determines the allocation of the limited number of places. Information on the rental contract and handing over the keys can be obtained from the International Office. The monthly rent for a room in a student hall of residence is approximately 325-365 Euros. In addition, a one-time deposit of 600 Euros is required.
Most rooms/flats on the private housing market are unfurnished (unlike the student residences at Trier University and some privately run student residences). Some accommodation offers do not include a kitchen. It is advisable to clarify this before moving in.
In Germany, both private flats and dormitory rooms always have a cancellation notice period. This is usually specified in the contract and is typically around three months. It is not possible to move out early, so make sure you adhere to the notice period.
Please note that in advance of your studies at Trier University, the financing for your complete stay in Germany must be clarified and secured. You will need at least 992 euros per month to finance your life in Trier. Most of the costs will be for rent, health insurance and your meals. In your first month, you will also have other costs. Usually you will have to pay a deposit for your flat. You will also have to pay the semester fee, which is currently around 380 euros. In order to apply for a visa, you will need to provide ⭷ proof of financial resources . In other words, you must prove that you can finance your studies in Trier.
Rent on the private housing market does not include utilities such as water, electricity or gas, and additional estate agent fees may apply when searching on the private housing market.
Is the rent for this type of flat realistic? • A room in a shared flat costs on average: 300–450€. • A one-room flat/studio costs 350–500€. • Furnished accommodation is more expensive than unfurnished.
above currently is around EUR 110 per month (reduced student fee).
transport_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：Trier University is a campus university, meaning that all of its buildings and facilities are concentrated in a relatively small area and are easily accessible by foot. The main campus (Campus I) and Campus II are situated about ten minutes walk from each other and there is also a shuttle bus between the two. The buildings on Campus I are surrounded by landscaped parkland and lakes, with sport, leisure and shopping facilities all available nearby. Campus II also has its share of greenery and borders onto Trier’s science and technology park.
The departments of Geography, Geoscience, Computer Sciences and Business Information Systems are based on Campus II, the faculty of Catholic Theology is located in the E-building and downtown Trier. All other departments are found on Campus I. In your admission letter you will be informed of the departments to which you have been admitted.
campus_life_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：Gather additional information on the courses offered by the subjects on the websites of the subjects for exchange students (there you will usually find course lists from the current semesters and information on credit allocation). These and the contact persons in the subjects, who you can also contact with specific questions about course selection, can be found here.
Language Courses: Would you also like to learn German or other languages at Trier University? Then take a look at the courses offered by the Language Centre. The Language Centre is part of the University and the courses are free of charge for all Trier University students. German Courses: Each semester, intensive courses as well as additional module courses are offered at various proficiency levels (typically A and B levels). If you have any questions about German courses, please contact: Ms. Zita van Wylick (ECTS Coordinator for German Courses). Registration for the courses and the placement test generally take place during the week before the start of the lecture period or the orientation program. A preliminary overview in English can be found here.
After arrival at Trier University, you will receive your Trier student ID card, the "Tunika". You will receive authorization to use the computers at the University, including instructions on how to access the Wi-Fi on campus, your own email address and the course catalogue (PORTA) well before arrival.
How to sign up for exams is covered on these pages: 🡒 Course selection 🡒 End of Stay

student_guide_sections.summary:

Have you been nominated by your home university to study at Trier University? If so, let yourself be inspired by the variety of courses! At Trier University, you can expand your studies according to your wishes with a German perspective on your field of study and beyond. The Orientation Programme for international students makes it easier for you to settle into student life in Trier.
If you are a student participating in an exchange programme (e.g. ERASMUS, ISEP, partner universities) and have been nominated by your home university to study at Trier University, you will find information here on your application and admission to Trier University.

If you start your studies at Trier University in the winter semester , your application procedure starts in April of the same year. The application deadline is 1 June .
If you start your studies at Trier University in the summer semester , your application procedure starts in October of the previous year. The application deadline is 15 December .
If you start your studies at Trier University in the winter semester , your application procedure starts in April of the same year. The application deadline is 1 June .

student_guide_sections.title: 生活及交通來源
student_guide_sections.summary:
Trier University is a campus university, meaning that all of its buildings and facilities are concentrated in a relatively small area and are easily accessible by foot. The main campus (Campus I) and Campus II are situated about ten minutes walk from each other and there is also a shuttle bus between the two. The buildings on Campus I are surrounded by landscaped parkland and lakes, with sport, leisure and shopping facilities all available nearby. Campus II also has its share of greenery and borders onto Trier’s science and technology park.
The departments of Geography, Geoscience, Computer Sciences and Business Information Systems are based on Campus II, the faculty of Catholic Theology is located in the E-building and downtown Trier. All other departments are found on Campus I. In your admission letter you will be informed of the departments to which you have been admitted.

housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：Facilitating accommodation applications for university-managed properties and preferred partner providers, as well as connecting you with residential colleges and private rentals.
Arranging temporary accommodation for students as well as managing bookings for academic visitors.
Living in student accommodation is an excellent way to settle into university life. This type of housing is provided exclusively to students, meaning you’ll be part of a welcoming, like-minded community full of fellow students.
Most student accommodation comes fully furnished and equipped with essential resources for effective study. In most cases, utilities and wifi are connected, and these costs are included in your accommodation fee, making it easy for you to budget your finances.
We recommend student accommodation for at least your first year of study, giving you time to settle into your new routine. We find that students who choose to live in student accommodation in the first year are generally better prepared to thrive in shared or private rental accommodation in subsequent years.

Slovenians with no Slovenian citizenship receiving a scholarship by the Republic of Slovenia (Public Scholarship, Development, Disability and Maintenance Fund of the Republic of Slovenia) may apply for a room at the Student resident halls. The Regulations on fees and accommodation in students’ dormitories for Slovene nationals without Slovene citizenship and foreigners in the Republic of Slovenia provide that up to 250 places are to be offered in Student resident halls for the recipients of ministry scholarship. Available places for the residence of scholarship recipients are assigned by the Ministry responsible for higher education in cooperation with scholarship providers. Recipients of ministry scholarships are charged a subsidized rent. The Ministry or scholarship provider pays the rent directly to the student dorm, i.e. from the scholarship amount granted.

About me Hello! My name is Una Lajić and I am currently in the last year of my undergraduate studies as a Marketing student at the School of Economics and Business, University of Ljubljana. Since moving to Slovenia in 2023, I quickly integrated within the new environment, joining and becoming an active member of the student organisation of SEB LU all in the first week of my 1st year. Becoming an International Student Ambassador for the University of Ljubljana two years ago, I have actively taken on the responsibility of promoting and representing the institution, facilitating guidance to international students during the adaptation process regarding studies and integration into the new life in Slovenia. Taking into account that I have been in the same shoes you are currently in, facing numerous decisions ahead, knowing how difficult it is to leave your country, choose the right faculty and a place that you will call your new home, I’d be happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the university and student life here in Ljubljana!
Study program and level 3rd year undergraduate student in International Business at the Faculty of Economics and Business, University of Ljubljana

student_guide_sections.title: 接待校本期文件
student_guide_sections.summary:
Students with the status of a person with temporary protection can submit an application for admission of subsidized accommodation in Student dormitory for the academic year 2025/2026. More information and application. Here you can also find the application form in English.
You can apply for the subsidised transport at the selling points or you can fill in the Application Form for a subsidised ticket * online. The fare is paid by the URBANA card. The student subsidised Urbana card for city bus in Ljubljana is 20€ per month .
We have prepared a guide for you on how to fill out the application form for a temporary residence permit and explain what details you need to pay attention to and what documents you need to prepare before you arrive in Slovenia.

housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：NB. If a “NO” button is selected, whilst the student is staying in an accredited accommodation, the student will be liable for the transport cost or it will be at his/her own account
The Tshwane University of Technology (TUT) is one of the largest residential educational institutions in South Africa. There are private student accommodation options, but first-year students should apply and register for University-owned accommodation, managed by ARLC. ARLC accommodation has the advantage of being on campus, or reliable transport provided by the University, if situated off campus. ARLC residences are furthermore well managed with experienced residence advisors, a strong governance system with many residence life opportunities organised by residence committees. There is furthermore a mentorship programme, according to which residents are placed according to course of study. Mentors are appointed for each resident to provide academic and mental well-being support.
When to apply for residence accommodation When a student applies for academic acceptance at TUT, they should also indicate their need for student accommodation. Applicants will be notified when they have been provisionally placed in a residence. Once a student has registered for academic study, he/she must register on-line in a residence to secure a space. Available spaces are filled on a first-come-first-served basis. With regard to residence application and registration, the following applies:

What are the student selection criteria in the competition for studies abroad? Students' selection criteria are: academic results of 2 last semesters, compatibility of courses between home and host universities, motivation, level of English and other foreign languages k n owledge . How to choose the university for studies abroad? For studies in EU countries: See the list of announced universities for the ongoing competition, choose the country/university according to your department/study field and check the course catalogues pu b lished on the websites of host universities. Contact the VMU academic coordinator regarding the courses’ compatibility. For studies in non-EU countries: See the list of announced universities for the ongoing competition, choose the country and check the course catalogues pu b lished on the websites of host universities. Contact the VMU academic coordinator regarding the courses’ compatibility. Note: pay attention to the language of instruction and evaluate if your level of foreign language knowledge is sufficient. Will my courses be recognized when I return? The students must carefully choose the university by checking the course catalogue announced for the incoming exchange students on the websites of host universities before submitting the application for the scholarship competition. Academic coordinators in the faculties are ready to answer all your studies-related questions. The courses will be recognized after you return if the Learning Agreement (a document which consists of the list of courses approved by the sending and receiving universities) is submitted properly. What are the accommodation possibilities abroad? Many universities offer dormitory accommodation. Students prefer choosing this type of accommodation for better integration. Some universities cannot offer enough places in dormitories, therefore students need to check this information beforehand. Please note: accommodation fees in the USA are higher than in other countries: ~10.000 $/semester. How can I get more practical information about host universities? Contact the exchange programmes' ambassadors for more practical information.

How easy is this? All your daily destinations — the places you hit to rest, recharge, and relax — are tucked into a compact campus shaded by towering trees and crisscrossed by walking paths. Cozy. Close. Convenient. With a variety of housing and dining options, you’ll find a space that feels like home.
Unpack those pillows and posters. You’re home! First-year students live together in on-campus residence halls reserved just for them. Options for upper-level students expand to suites, apartments, and townhouses on campus, as well as the privately run Campus Town apartments adjacent to campus. Pop into your room from anywhere on campus in 11 minutes, tops.
Residential Education, Housing, and Dining Eickhoff Hall, Room 114 The College of New Jersey PO Box 7718 2000 Pennington Rd. Ewing, NJ 08628
How easy is this? All your daily destinations — the places you hit to rest, recharge, and relax — are tucked into a compact campus shaded by towering trees and crisscrossed by walking paths. Cozy. Close. Convenient. With a variety of housing and dining options, you’ll find a space that feels like home.
Summer housing is available only for undergraduate TCNJ students enrolled in summer classes, working full-time for a college department, participating in a summer program approved by Residential Education and Housing (i.e. MUSE), or those experiencing housing insecurity. Summer housing will be located in Hausdoerffer or Phelps Hall for Session 1, 2, 3 and all of MUSE. Students living on campus for the upcoming Fall semester that are here for Session 3 will be asked to move in to that assignment early. Although rare, students who are here for consecutive sessions may be required to move rooms in order to maximize our space and occupancy needs.
What is the cost of Winter Break Housing? Students can view all housing rates on our room and board rates webpage . No meal plan will be available for the winter session. Information on whether or not a Dining location will be open in the Student Center will be forthcoming. When is the application deadline for Winter Break Housing? Applications need to be submitted through MyHousing by 11:59pm on Sunday, November 30, 2025 in order for the student to move in on Monday, December 22, 2025 or  Monday, December 29th, 2025.  Applications will continue to be accepted after Sunday, November 30th, 2025, based on availability of spaces. Information on how students will be able to move into their Travers or Wolfe room will be sent to students after they apply and are assigned. Where do students live for the winter? For the winter session students may be required to consolidate in to Travers and Wolfe Halls. Specific details and instructions for winter housing locations will be provided closer to the start of this period. Is there a meal plan associated with Winter Break Housing? There will not be a meal plan associated with winter housing. Winter Break Housing residents will have ID access to the Townhouse South kitchen (within the South lounge.) Please make appropriate preparations for food over the course of your winter stay. What if I need to cancel my Winter Break Housing application? Please contact Residential Education and Housing immediately at housing@tcnj.edu to cancel your winter housing assignment. If possible all cancellations should be submitted before midnight on Monday, December 1, 2025. What if I am an athlete, international student, or housing insecure student who needs to live on campus over Winter Break? If you need to live on campus over Winter Break, you will need to apply for Winter Break Housing on MyHousing . All break housing requests can be made through the “Requests and Forms” tab on MyHousing. What if my question is not answered here? Please contact Residential Education and Housing at housing@tcnj.edu , 609-771-2301, or 609-771-3455 and we will be more than happy to assist you with any questions you have.

Live on campus in our graduate student housing called Lofts on Lee, at the bustling Spartan Village – a mix of residential and commercial space.
What if learning could transform an entire community? This inspiring presentation shares how a Physics teacher in Cameroon went beyond the classroom to tackle real-world challenges affecting students’ success. By introducing renewable energy solutions, improving study conditions, and launching a community agribusiness initiative, students gained opportunities to connect science with everyday life. Discover how teachers can become changemakers, empower students, strengthen communities, and use education as a powerful tool for sustainable development.

school_name: 愛丁堡大學 The University of Edinburgh
cost_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：For 2026-2027, we estimate that it will cost an average of £1,546 each month to live in Edinburgh as a single undergraduate student. This equates to £13,914 for a 39-week academic year and £18,552 for a full year. This amount does not include study costs (like tuition fees) and will likely rise each year with inflation.
Find tuition fees and additional study costs on the degree finder
Tuition fee rates for international students are available on the Scholarships and Student Funding website. Fees are listed by course and level (undergraduate, postgraduate or study abroad students).
If you plan to make any regular payments through direct debit (tuition fees, rent or household bills), or are receiving any support loans, it is recommended that you open a bank account in the UK. Learn about your options for opening your first student bank account in the UK on the New Students website.
Consider these numbers as a guide only. Living costs can be affected significantly by things like inflation, energy costs, exchange rates and global events.
Self-catered costs are based on the daily recommended minimum amounts of money for food per person (Western food types) from Numbeo cost of living database.
Budgeting for bills and utilities is an important part of planning for university life. The cost of living can vary greatly depending on your lifestyle, budget and spending habits.
You should make sure your accommodation fees and living costs are fully planned before starting your programme of study.
housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：Accommodation and utilities amount is the average of all self-catered accommodation options. University accommodation is only available for 39-week leases.
Accommodation options for undergraduate students:
Please be aware that there are deadlines for accommodation applications. Find out more about University accommodation applications on the New Students website.
We guarantee an offer of accommodation for all eligible undergraduate students from outside Edinburgh.
We have listed these costs per month, but some accommodation types may require you to pay on a different schedule.
University catered and self-catered costs are an average of undergraduate housing on the University of Edinburgh Accommodation website, with the ranges showing the cheapest and most expensive options. A twin room shared with another student in a self-catered block is usually the cheapest option for University accommodation.
There are a range of costs associated with financing your studies at the University of Edinburgh, including fees and accommodation.
The rent for accommodation that we own or manage typically includes:
transport_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：a student bus pass from Lothian buses for £58 per month or £570 for a 9-month advance purchase pass
Edinburgh Waverley train station and Edinburgh Bus Station are within walking distance of our Central campus, but buses and taxis are available, too. We provide discounts for train and coach travel.
We strongly recommend that you travel to the University using public transport, as parking near our campuses will be extremely limited.

Although there are student dormitories operated by local governments and universities, approximately 70% of international students live in private houses or apartments/condominiums. It is advised that you begin doing research on accommodation as soon as you receive notification of your acceptance to the university. You can find information regarding accommodation 1) at the school's international student office, 2) online, or 3) by checking with real estate agents in the area you wish to live in.

housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：For your stay in France, you have many housing options. You can choose between a publicly owned building or a private one, and between a student residence or an apartment that you may occupy alone, with other students, or with a family or local resident. Don’t panic! We’ll decode the various types of housing available to students and help you in your search.
And don’t forget to ask the staff at your educational institution if they can help. Some institutions (especially the Grandes Ecoles ), maintain a stock of housing or have a system for connecting their students with housing providers.
If you have the student status (as a doctoral student), you can ask for accommodation in a student residence . Don't wait until the last second before asking.
Intergenerational housing is another option. It offers free or low-cost accommodation in exchange for
The residences managed by France’s regional centers for student services, known as CROUS ( centres régionaux des œuvres universitaires et scolaires ), are publicly owned and subsidized by the French government. CROUS buildings are the first choice of many students for the advantages they offer : the monthly rent is low (€450 in Paris; €350 on average elsewhere in France). The buildings are close to campus, and the opportunities for social interaction with other students are plentiful. In fact, the only drawback to CROUS rooms is that they are hard to get, because demand far exceeds supply.
4. Lokaviz lists all of the units available in CROUS residences, as well as space offered by individual property owners. There’s no cost to review the posted vacancies. All of the units listed on the site have earned the Lokaviz label, so students can be sure they’re renting decent housing .
Compare what the different banks offer. The costs of the bank card, international transfers and cash withdrawals abroad may vary noticeably from one bank to another.
Vélib’ in Paris, Vélov’ in Lyon and Vélo Bleu in Nice: most big French cities have self-service bicycle rental. An annual subscription – between 15 and 30 euros on average – is the easiest way to use it.

student_guide_sections.title: 保險
student_guide_sections.summary:
Social Security provides foreign students with social coverage while studying in France. To increase the amount of their healthcare expenses that is reimbursed, they may take out complementary health insurance, or mutuelle.
Students with the nationality of a country from the European Union, from Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway or Switzerland have access to the European Health Insurance Card (EHIC). They don't need to register for French Student Social Security. This card must be requested in your country of origin and be valid until at least the end of the academic year.
Counselling centres, called Bureaux d’aide psychologique universitaires (BAPU, University Counselling Offices), welcome students in need of psychological assistance to meet with professionals such as psychotherapists and social workers. These consultations are 100% covered by health insurance and mutual insurance companies.
Apply for a health insurance card ("carte Vitale")

student_guide_sections.summary:

guide_photos.alt: The building in the image is the Crystal of Knowledge Library (Perpustakaan Crystal of Knowledge), which serves as the main library of Universitas Indonesia (UI). Located at the Depok Campus, this library is a landmark known for its modern and futuristic architectural design, with angular and geometric shapes that resemble crystals. The building is surrounded by a lake and lush greenery, creating a peaceful academic environment. The library has a futuristic, crystalline shape with a combination of glass, steel, and concrete materials. The large glass windows allow natural light to enter, making it an energy-efficient and eco-friendly. It is one of the largest university libraries in Southeast Asia. Houses a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources. Includes reading rooms, discussion areas, study lounges, and multimedia rooms. Features high-speed internet access and digital library services. Apart from being a library, it also serves as a venue for seminars, workshops, and exhibitions. Hosts academic and cultural events, supporting both students and researchers. Features an auditorium and event spaces. Built near Kampus UI Lake (Danau UI), providing a tranquil setting for study and research. The surrounding greenery and walkways make it a popular spot for relaxation. The building incorporates eco-friendly designs, including natural lighting and ventilation. Supports UI’s commitment to green campus initiatives. — File:Ui Central Library, Crystal of Knowledge Library.jpg

student_guide_sections.summary:
Spring 2027 exchange students can find the details of accommodation application on this page.
Students interested in opting out of KGU-Arranged accommodations should carefully read the Advice to Self-Arranged Accommodation Students before making a final decision.
Although there are student dormitories operated by local governments and universities, approximately 70% of international students live in private houses or apartments/condominiums. It is advised that you begin doing research on accommodation as soon as you receive notification of your acceptance to the university. You can find information regarding accommodation 1) at the school's international student office, 2) online, or 3) by checking with real estate agents in the area you wish to live in.
There are three dormitories for male students—Keimeiryo, Seishuryo, and Seizenryo.

student_guide_sections.title: 接待校語言
student_guide_sections.summary:
The university offers an undergraduate program in “Chinese L anguage”, speci fically designed to recruit and cultivate international talents in Chinese studies . The curriculum emphasizes enhancing students’ practical Chinese language proficiency , integrating traditional Chinese culture and national conditions, and combining fundamental theoretical knowledge of the language . After four years of study, students will achieve a high level of Chinese proficiency , obtain the HSK Level 5 certificate , and gain an in-depth understanding of traditional Chinese culture. They will become international ly competitive, application-oriented Chinese language professionals who are well-acquainted with China’s national conditions and cultural background, process strong cross-cultural communication skills , and meet the demands of modern society.
( V ) Language Proficiency Requirements for Admission:
学 校设有 “汉语言”本科专业， 专项招收培养国际中文人才。课程内容注重提升学生中文运用能力，融入中国传统文化与国情课程，兼具基础汉语理论知识。学生通过四年学习将具备较高的中文水平，获得汉语水平五级证书 (HSK 5)，同时沉浸式接受中国传统文化熏陶，成为熟悉中国国情和文化背景、具备较强中外跨文化交际能力、适应现代社会需求的国际化应用型中文人才。
原则上不做中文水平要求，已获得 HSK4级以上证书者优先推荐留学生奖学金。毕业于 马来西亚华文独立中学（以中国驻马来西亚大使馆认证为准）毕业者， 无需汉语水平证书 。高中阶段以中文作为授课语言的申请者，可凭高中出具的授课证明做作为代替。

student_guide_sections.title: 接待校語言
student_guide_sections.summary:
大学・大学院への進学を見据え、日本語能力や情報活用能力等の学術活動の基礎となる能力を養うことができます。
関西大学は、国際化構想の一環として、2012年4月に開設した南千里国際プラザに留学生別科を設置しています。 関西大学留学生別科では、日本語能力に加え、ICT(情報通信技術)を学習に活用して情報活用能力を養うなど、大学・大学院での学術活動の基礎能力の養成も積極的に支援します。
大学・大学院への進学を見据え、日本語能力や情報活用能力等の学術活動の基礎となる能力を養うことができます。
関西大学では 学生交換協定 に基づき、協定大学から毎年4月と9月に外国人学生を交換受入留学生として受け入れています。本プログラムで受けられる授業科目は「外国人留学生科目」と「KUGF科目」に分かれ、「外国人留学生科目」は日本語で、「KUGF科目」は英語で授業を行います。さらにプレースメントテストにより十分な日本語能力があると判断された学生は、各学部で開講している科目についても受講できる可能性があります。なお、関西大学の担当教員の大学院演習科目の履修を希望する場合は、問い合わせ先よりお問合せください。

student_guide_sections.title: 接待校本期文件
student_guide_sections.summary:
PDFファイルへ入力する出願書類は、Webブラウザ上ではなく Adobe Reader を使用して入力してください。
日本に住む、日本国籍を持たない避難民・難民のみなさんは、以下いずれかのプログラムから応募してください。 日本教育パスウェイズ UNHCR難民高等教育プログラム（RHEP） プログラムへの応募期間は、例年7月初旬～8月初旬です。また、出願資格や出願書類が一部異なるため、よく確認してください。
よって、大学推薦に関する全ての事項（募集要件及び学内での募集〆切日等）については、留学生が推薦者として選ばれた際に本学教員より個別に連絡することとします。なお、申請書類提出後は、本学内での選考を経て採用候補者を選出し、最終的に、文部科学省からの正式な採用結果を本学から連絡致します。本学では、大学推薦制度として「一般枠」を募集します。
指導教員を通さずに提出された申請書類については、本学では受理致しませんのでご注意ください。

交換留学とは、本学の学生交換協定校へ龍谷大学の代表として派遣されるもので、学費の免除はもちろん、協定校によっては奨学金を受けることも可能な制度です。原則として毎年同数の学生を派遣・受け入れしています。
留学期間は原則1年間または半年間です。その間の龍谷大学の学費も免除となりますが、留学在籍料が必要です。なお、留学先大学の都合により、年度途中であっても、条件が変更になる場合や、募集を行わない場合がありますので、最新の情報はグローバル教育推進センターホームページで確認して下さい。

transport_summary: 接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：二是形成多元协同的感知生态。"感知中国"活动突破了以往高校单打独斗的分散模式，逐步形成了政府引导、高校承办、企业支持、社会参与的多元协同教育生态。例如，这次的西安行活动，由国家留学基金委主办、同济大学承办，活动还得到新东方前途出国以及西安交通大学和长安大学等知名企业和高校的大力支持。这种协同机制不仅实现了资源优化配置，也为来华留学生提供了更为丰富和多元的学习体验，标志着来华留学教育向系统化、生态化方向发展。

housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：We are proud of our student housing because it's more than just a simple room or apartment. We offer a variety of services and activities to create a feeling of community and we continue to renovate and upgrade facilities to meet the ever-changing needs of our student body. Living Learning Communities offer a specialized living experience with connections to faculty and staff to create supportive communities that focus on student success. Residence Life teams across all communities foster learning through interactions with roommates, floormates, community programs, clubs and activities.
ZeeMee is how future and new Florida Tech students connect, make friends, and find roommates. Download the ZeeMee app and use the channels on our page to connect with potential roommates. New students can request roommates on their housing application.

We are proud of our student housing because it's more than just a simple room or apartment. We offer a variety of services and activities to create a feeling of community and we continue to renovate and upgrade facilities to meet the ever-changing needs of our student body. Living Learning Communities offer a specialized living experience with connections to faculty and staff to create supportive communities that focus on student success. Residence Life teams across all communities foster learning through interactions with roommates, floormates, community programs, clubs and activities.
ZeeMee is how future and new Florida Tech students connect, make friends, and find roommates. Download the ZeeMee app and use the channels on our page to connect with potential roommates. New students can request roommates on their housing application.

For the application documents required for visa extension, processing procedures and methods, fee basis and standards, etc., you can visit the official website of China's National Immigration Administration and refer to the Guide on Visa Extension, Change and Reissuance for Foreigners under "Services". The requirements for the photos for travel documents can be found in the Guidelines for Travel Documents Photographs in the "Services" section. Additionally, you can find the office address and contact information of local exit-entry reception halls in "Office Enquiries" under "Services". You can also dial 12367 for further information.

1927年，李书田应北洋大学校长刘仙洲之邀返校任教，讲授土木工程专业的课程，开始了他长达近60年的教育生涯。李书田重视教学与科研相结合，除了在北洋任教外，还担任华北水利委员会的委员兼秘书长一职。1930年，李书田到交通大学唐山土木工程学院任院长，到校不及一年就为该校添设了矿冶工程系和研究院，促进了唐山地区的科研事业。1931年4月，在李书田的努力下，中国水利工程学会得以建立，他任该学会副会长。1932年9月，李书田任北洋工学院（北洋大学当时的校名）院长。此后5年间，他为学校发展做了大量卓有成效的工作：学校的工程学馆、工程实验馆、新图书馆相继竣工并投入使用；学校多种学术期刊蓬勃发展；重新创作了校歌；各系增设了近20个实验室，增添了设备；1935年，学校创办“工科研究所”，开创了研究生培养的先河，使北洋工学院成为国内高校中最早招收研究生的大学之一；他力促建成了“天津水工实验所”，后改称“中国第一水工实验所”。1937年2月，李书田制定了《国立北洋大学筹备缘起及分期完成计划》，提出了用16年时间，将北洋大学建设成为工理文法医相结合的综合性一流大学的奋斗目标。

student_guide_sections.title: 接待校語言
student_guide_sections.summary: 国际教育学院（卫斯理安学院）是广州大学国际化建设的重要窗口，是学校来华留学教育和学生出国交流学习的管理服务机构。学院承担来华留学生招生、日常管理和对外汉语教学工作，是孔子学院总部/国家汉办授权的HSK（汉语水平考试）考点。根据高水平大学建设要求，立足开放办学需要，学院不断开拓进取，为来华留学生提供优质教育服务和多方位的跨文化交流平台。

school_name: 天普大學 Temple University
cost_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：International students are required to show tuition for 2 academic semesters +  estimated living expenses of $15,000 + $8700 in estimated fees for books,  health insurance and supplies etc. To determine your estimated fees:
Regardless of whether you live on campus or off  campus, you will have living expenses. This includes rent, utilities,  groceries, etc.    Living expenses are currently estimated at $15,000.00 per year. This sum must be added to the tuition and fees listed at https://bursar.temple.edu/tuition-and-fees/tuition-rates .
If you have a friend or family member who will be supplying room and board, they can complete the form available at https://isss.temple.edu/file/room-and-board-affidavitpdf. That form should be uploaded  and will  cover the estimated living expenses of $15,00.00. You would be responsible for provided financial documentation that covered the tuition and the estimated fees for  books, insuract etc which are set at $4,000.00

housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：SFSU has a variety of housing communities, room types and meal plans for you to choose from. Whatever you’re looking for, we have a space that’s right for you.
Ready to apply? Click the link below to learn about the application process, important application dates and deadlines, and to find answers to housing application FAQs.
Whether you prefer traditional residence hall, suite, or apartment-style housing, SFSU has a variety of housing communities and room types. Whatever you’re looking for, we have a space that’s right for you.
Curious about what it’s really like to live on campus? In-person housing tours will be available this summer for students attending orientation and throughout the year as part of the main campus tour. These tours will give you the chance to explore the inside of select communities and ask any questions you may have. There’s no better way to picture your future home away from home.
All housing and meal plan fees are subject to change. Download Acrobat Reader to view PDF files.
As a benefit of living on campus, residents will have $100,000 in liability insurance provided for them through SF State and GradGuard. This liability coverage is included in your housing fees and protects you financially in the event you cause unintentional damage to your room or apartment due to fire, smoke, explosion, or the discharge of a sprinkler head.
To cancel a housing application or decline a space prior to the fee period, applicants are required to provide a 15-day cancellation notice in order to receive a refund of the initial payment. Applicants who have not yet submitted the initial payment may cancel at any time.
Find your new home! Before you apply, take a virtual tour of our residential community and explore our available housing options. Once you've identified your preferred community and room type, review the associated housing fees and meal plan requirements for your selected community.

Therefore, we encourage you to secure housing as soon as possible.

housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：The opening of Suffolk's sixth residence hall represents an exciting new chapter for both students and downtown Boston.
Your studies and college life in Boston extend well beyond the classroom thanks to our downtown location. As a Suffolk student, you'll have the best of both university and city worlds right outside your door, with on-campus dining, University housing, and student services, as well as all the sights, sounds, and excitement of a major downtown hub. Boston's arts and entertainment scene, diverse cuisine, history, public transportation, and more will form the dynamic backdrop of your college experience.
University Housing Visit Off Campus Housing Summer Housing Dining Options Student Resources
Suffolk University offers resources for students searching for off-campus housing. We can help you get started with finding a roommate and available housing in the Boston area. You can also contact us if you have any additional questions.
Suffolk University Residence Life and Housing Services will help you find the university housing and university dining options that best fit your life. Our students are diverse, including our international students from 108 different countries. And wherever you’re from, we want you to feel at home. From our dining halls and meal plans to finding an off-campus apartment, our advisors will help you make the most of studying and living in Boston.

housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：Affordability is a key factor in choosing a university. UW-Stout Polytechnic is ranked as one of the United States' most affordable public universities. Be sure to compare apples to apples when considering other schools, and examine factors such as what your tuition and residence hall fees include, on-campus employment, internships, and scholarships .
At UW-Stout Polytechnic, we provide on-campus employment opportunities and paid internships with our industry partners. As an on-campus, undergraduate student your tuition and residence hall fees include textbooks, a laptop with software, and all of the essentials for your room. Plus, we have thousands of dollars in scholarships set aside specifically for international students.
Housing staff is available by phone or video chat (on Microsoft Teams) Monday-Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm
Many international students live and eat on campus. The housing contract reserves your room and meal plan for the school year, and you can also choose to live on campus during the summer ( no summer meal plan available ). Suite-style housing may be available on campus. On-campus graduate housing is most likely not available.  For some students choosing to live off campus, costs are similar, depending upon the type of apartment or shared house.
campus_life_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：⁠Graduate Assistantships (GAs) are paid positions at UW-Stout Polytechnic where you also have the opportunity to gain valuable professional experience. The process for finding a GA position here is a bit different than on some campuses. Openings are posted on Handshake by academic programs and administrative units, and the process of searching for one and applying is much like finding any other kind of employment. You must meet all of the following criteria to hold a Graduate Assistantship (GA): •    admitted to a graduate degree program (dual-level and non-degree seeking students are not eligible), •    enrolled in at least six graduate credits each term, and •    maintain a GPA of at least 3.0 each term.
To remain eligible for this scholarship, recipients must renew it each semester. Renewal is contingent upon fulfilling the global involvement requirement, earning at least 15 credits per semester to maintain full-time enrollment, and maintaining a cumulative UW-Stout Polytechnic undergraduate cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher each semester.
To remain eligible for this scholarship, recipients must renew it each semester. Renewal is contingent upon fulfilling the global involvement requirement, earning at least 9 credits per semester to maintain full-time enrollment, and maintaining a cumulative UW-Stout Polytechnic undergraduate cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher each semester.

What is the most important thing in college students’ life? Apart from the romantically infused sight of cherry blossoms in spring and the wisdom imparted by teachers to the studious, commuting remains a common concern. Transportation is significant for a campus that covers 5915 acres , with teaching and living facilities scattered around. Thanks to the efforts of Wuhan University (WHU), several measures have been taken to improve students’ commute inside this large campus.
For most students, electric bicycles and school buses are the top two choices to cope with hilly streets and little travel time. However, electric bicycles are dangerous for drivers and school buses can be time-consuming. Improving measures related to these two means of transport have become one of the greatest concerns of the relevant university authorities, resulting in several changes.

What is the most important thing in college students’ life? Apart from the romantically infused sight of cherry blossoms in spring and the wisdom imparted by teachers to the studious, commuting remains a common concern. Transportation is significant for a campus that covers 5915 acres , with teaching and living facilities scattered around. Thanks to the efforts of Wuhan University (WHU), several measures have been taken to improve students’ commute inside this large campus.
For most students, electric bicycles and school buses are the top two choices to cope with hilly streets and little travel time. However, electric bicycles are dangerous for drivers and school buses can be time-consuming. Improving measures related to these two means of transport have become one of the greatest concerns of the relevant university authorities, resulting in several changes.

NEWS NEWS 2026（第二届）上海高质量国际人才交流会暨HSK高校来华留学就业展举行 5月10日，由复旦大学、汉考国际联合主办的“2026（第二届）上海高质量国际人才交流会暨高校来华留学就业展”在复旦大学正大体育馆开幕。教育部中外语言交流合作中心副主任杨洲、上海市教育委员会副主任叶霖霖、复旦大学党委副书记方明、上海市出入境管理总队副总队长胡鹰、阿里国际数字商业集团Lazada执行副总裁刘歆杨等嘉宾出席开幕式。京东、阿里、小米、腾讯等50家知名企业，以及复旦大学、北京大学、清华大学、上海交通大学等近40余所全国知名高校代表，与来自世界各地的来华留学生、归国中文教师及志愿者3000多人齐聚复旦，共绘国际人才发展新图景。开幕式上，杨洲在致辞中表示，以上海为代表的中国式现代化建设持续释放活力，吸引越来越多国际青年来华发展。目前，语合中心已与全球190多个国家开展中文教育合作，支持设立83个中文学习测试中心和1477个HSK考点，年考生超81万人次，全球中文学习者达2.1亿。作为语合中心指导汉考国际打造的品牌项目，“HSK留学中国与就业展”已在51国举办200余场，服务90余万人次，帮助20余万学习者来华留学或就业。他表示，语合中心将与各界合作伙伴积极构建“标准制定——课程培训— 2026-05-12

student_guide_sections.title: 接待校資格
student_guide_sections.summary:
To apply for the exchange program, you need to contact the international office of your home university in order to be nominated as an exchange student.
To attend NJU as an exchange student, you must be nominated by one of NJU’s partner universities. The student exchange office of your home university will determine your eligibility for an exchange program. Please contact them for application details.
Our office will only review materials of students nominated by coordinator of home university. If you are a self-paying student, please refer to the on-line website of Institute for International Students for application: 海外教育学院 (nju.edu.cn) or contact: issd@nju.edu.cn

student_guide_sections.summary:
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Gulou campus (about 45 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 22). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Gulou station and then take the second exit. You may call a taxi (for about RMB 11) or take a 15-minute walk to the dormitory
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Xianlin campus (about 60 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 50). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Xinjiekou Station and then take metro line 2(toward Jingtian Street) inside the station. Take exit 1 at Nanjing University Xianlin Campus Station. You may take a 20-minute walk to the dormitory.

housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：We’re proud to be able to provide accommodation to all undergraduate students who require it. All our undergraduate freshers (first-year students) are housed on our main college site, right in the heart of Oxford. You’ll be at the centre of our college community, close to the common room and dining hall, and living alongside other new students.
Graduate applicants who receive either a conditional or unconditional offer from Hertford are invited to apply for college accommodation via a separate application form sent by the Hertford Accommodation Office.
Application process Applications are processed in three allocation rounds (normally April, May and June). Following each round, applicants will either: receive an accommodation offer; or be notified that they remain under consideration for the next round. Applicants who are unsuccessful after the final round may join a waiting list. If you have a disability or medical requirement affecting accommodation, this must be declared in your application and registered with the University’s Disability Advisory Service (DAS) so that it can be prioritised during the allocation process.
Rent (2026–27) Graduate accommodation is charged at a flat rate of £29.47 per night , regardless of room size, location or facilities. Standard licence (19 September 2026 to 13 July 2027): £8,752.59 Please note that a few properties have different licence dates, which will be advised as part of the application process. Additional nights may be available before or after the standard licence period (although this is not guaranteed) and are charged at the nightly rate. Charges increase annually on 1 August. Rent includes: all utilities basic contents insurance (provided by Howdens ) Wi-Fi Students should budget separately for laundry costs. Pay-per-use laundry facilities are available in a number of college accommodation buildings.

student_guide_sections.title: 保險
student_guide_sections.summary:
Die gesetzliche Krankenversicherung in Österreich erstattet den Versicherten die Kosten für erforderliche medizinische Behandlungen. EU/EWR Staatsbürger*innen erhalten in den Ländern der EU über Ihre European Health Insurance Card (= Rückseite der ecard) ebenfalls kostenlose medizinische Versorgung für alle Behandlungen, die während des Auslandsaufenthalts medizinisch notwendig sind (Kontroll- und Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sind hiervon in der Regel ausgenommen). Sollten Sie nicht in Österreich versichert sein oder Staatsbürger*in eines Drittstaats sein, klären Sie den Auslandsversicherungsschutz bitte mit Ihrer Krankenversicherung direkt.
Erasmus+ Studierende müssen sich selbstständig um eine ausreichende Kranken- bzw. Reiseversicherung sorgen. In der Regel sind EU/EWR Staatsbürger*innen über die Europäische Krankenversicherungskarte (EHIC – European Health Insurance Card) krankenversichert. Mit der EHIC Karte erhalten Sie bei Kassenärzt*innen in Österreich kostenlose medizinische Versorgung für alle Behandlungen, die während Ihres Aufenthalts medizinisch notwendig sind . Kontroll- und Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sind hiervon ausgenommen.

student_guide_sections.title: 接待校本期文件
student_guide_sections.summary:
２．在留資格（ビザ）オリエンテーション 出入国在留管理局への申請書類の提出や在留カードの受領は、学生本人に代わって駒澤大学が業務委託にて行っています。 日本政府により外国人政策が厳格化される中、在留資格の更新に関する重要な事項について説明します。 在留資格の更新ができなくなることもあるので、必ず参加してください。 【対象者】在留資格（ビザ）「留学」で在学する予定の人 【日　時】 2026年4月1日（水） 15：00～ 【場　所】駒沢キャンパス　1号館　1-204教場 【持ち物】 （1）筆記用具 （2）学生証（持っている人のみ） （3）パスポート （4）在留カード（交付されている人のみ） （5）スマートフォン、タブレット、またはノートパソコン 【問い合わせ】国際センター事務室 （駒沢キャンパス本部棟1階） kokusaicenter（a）komazawa-u.ac.jp ※（a）を@に変更してください。
出入国在留管理局への申請書類の提出や在留カードの受領について、駒澤大学が業務委託にて行っております。 つきましては、在留資格が「留学」の留学生は以下手順に従って、在留資格更新手続きを行ってください。 ※留学生（申請者）本人が、出入国在留管理局へ赴く必要はありません。

student_guide_sections.title: 交換费用
student_guide_sections.summary:
交換留学においては、留学期間の属する年度の駒澤大学の学費が減免されることがあります。それだけでなく、ほとんどの派遣先大学での授業料は免除になります。何かと経済的な負担の大きい留学にとっては、大きなメリットと言えるでしょう。
４.在留資格認定証明書（ＣＯＥ）交付申請について 大学で教育を受けるために必要な在留資格（「留学」など）を有していない方は、出入国在留管理局への申請手続が必要なため2次手続（学費納入）後、3月７日（土）までに国際センターへ申し出てください。

school_name: 美國佛羅里達州州立大學 Florida State University
housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：Tharpe: This area offers affordable housing and a quieter, residential feel. It can be a great fit for students who are proactive and prioritize a lower price point.
Housing staff is available to speak with students who have specific housing concerns that may not be reflected in the standard housing contract. We are committed to providing a safe and productive living environment for all students. Resources for students with specific needs are below.
University Housing offers graduate students the option to contract for housing on the main campus.
Housing contracts are available to students after they have been formally admitted to FSU. Admitted students can contract electronically by accessing our online contract . Students may also visit the Housing Office, located in the Student Life Center, and fill out a hard copy of the Housing Contract.
Understand Costs Beyond Rent: Be sure to clarify all fees, including application fees, administrative fees, security deposits, and parking fees. Ask which utilities are included and which you will be responsible for.
Tharpe: This area offers affordable housing and a quieter, residential feel. It can be a great fit for students who are proactive and prioritize a lower price point.
To be considered for an invitation to a Living–Learning Community, you must submit first your Housing Contract and $225 prepayment, then an online application for each Living–Learning Community of interest to you. Please see our Living–Learning Community webpage for additional information.
Each resident brings a different set of expectations. To encourage open communication, all residents discuss and sign a roommate agreement at the beginning of the fall term and any time there is a change in residence status in the room. When roommates are unable to resolve a situation on their own, a mediator is called upon to help. In mediation, an objective person, usually a University Housing staff member, acts as an arbitrator to ensure that strong feelings do not hinder the process and that roommates follow the rules. In the extreme cases in which mediation fails, arbitration will be used. In this process roommates agree beforehand to honor the arbitrator's decision. This binding decision may entail one or more roommates moving to another room. Students requesting to move to another room are obligated to their current room assignment until University Housing is able to find space available to accommodate the move.
transport_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：With one of the most compact campuses in the state, it's already easy to get around Florida State. But Transportation & Parking Services has made it even easier with a variety of services. Six multi-level garages, real-time parking availability counts, and valet services mean campus parking has never been easier. Seminole Express shuttle buses will quickly get you to and around campus. During late night hours, services such as S.A.F.E. Connection, Night Nole, and Nole Cab provide transportation around campus so you won't have to walk alone. If you're looking to get off campus, FSU students ride for free on all City of Tallahassee (StarMetro) buses, or you can pick up a Zipcar at one of three campus locations and go your own way.
Yes, the University provides a bus shuttle for the campus and surrounding areas. Further information may be obtained by contacting Parking Services at (850) 644-5278, on the Transportation website .

school_name: 加州州立大學 (長堤分校) California State University, Long Beach
housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：CSULB's housing options offer students a convenient and supportive living environment. On-campus housing provides students with a sense of community and the opportunity to get involved in campus life. Living on campus can also help students feel more connected to the university and make it easier to access academic and other resources.
There are several different housing options available at Long Beach State University. Each option offers a different living experience and caters to different student needs and preferences.
Housing Room Rates are structured by three tiers, then by room types, based on buildings and amenities. Please be sure to check out our Room Comparison Chart (PDF) .
Step 2 - Begin housing application on the Housing Portal (accessible through your MyCSULB SSO) Application will take 15-20 minutes to complete. Due to high demand, the application portal may not be available on your first attempt. Since applications are based on distance, students can apply any date and time between April 2 and priority date of May 1st. If you are applying before May 1st, the application is not first-come, first serve . If you are experiencing portal issues, try again later.
There are several different housing options available at Long Beach State University. Each option offers a different living experience and caters to different student needs and preferences.
Initial Payment ($275) An initial payment of $275 is required to complete the housing application. This is an addition to the $50 non-refundable application fee.
Current Residents: Defined as students who are currently residing on campus with University Housing
Returning Applicants: Defined as students who have previously been on-campus residents but are not currently in University Housing.

school_name: 維諾納州立大學 Winona State University
housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：Our residence halls are the heartbeat of Winona State. And our students will agree.
Our traditional residence halls are mainly double rooms, so most students have at least one roommate.
To access the housing application, you will need your StarID and password. If you need help with your StarID, call the Minnesota State Help Desk at 1.877.466.6728.
The housing application for Spring 2027 will open on Sept. 15.
Gender-Inclusive Housing is an option for students who would feel more comfortable living in a single room with a community restroom and shower that are designated as gender neutral.
Winona has a variety of rental options for college students, including studio apartments, apartment complexes, and rental houses. The Winona State Off-Campus Housing Marketplace is a great resource to find available rental units or subleases, connect with potential roommates, and buy or sell household items.
Whether you are new to WSU or a current student returning to the halls, the Housing & Residence Life office is happy to help you through the application process.
The cost for housing depends on the residence hall and room type you choose.

transport_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：地域連携 2026.04.13 留学生が一日警察署長として活躍　地域で交通安全を呼びかけ
4月7日、「春の全国交通安全運動出動式における広報啓発活動」が、道の駅みのりの郷 東金（千葉県東金市）で開催され、国際人文学部国際交流学科の留学生であるパトリシア ロンキエビチュさんが一日警察署長として交通事故防止に向けた注意喚起の広報活動や啓発物の配布を行いました。パトリシアさんは、ポーランド ワルシャワ大学からの交換留学生として本学で学んでおり、地域との交流や日本文化への関心の高さが評価され、このたび一日警察署長に任命されました。
委嘱式終了後は、道の駅みのりの郷 東金へ移動し、来店された方々に、終始笑顔で積極的に声をかけながら啓発物を手渡し、交通安全を呼びかけました。

Reach out whenever you need help but don't know where to go. The International Student Compliance Team can help you with your Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE), reducing your study load, taking Program Leave or meeting international student requirements. cost_summary:

Chico State is one of the only residential campuses within the California State University (CSU) system. This means most of our students live on, or within walking or biking distance (2km), of campus. Chico’s cost of living is great too—housing rentals are on average 50% less than those in the San Francisco and Los Angeles regions of California.
Off-Campus Housing Chico State’s central campus location allows students to live close enough to get a full college and community experience. Chico’s low cost of living lets you do it affordably.

Renter's Insurance Some housing providers may require renter's insurance and some may not. It is always recommended to have proper coverage in case the unexpected happens. Homeowner's Policy - Side Coverage - Some students may be covered under their parent's homeowners policy, however it is important not to just assume. If a parent wishes a student's rental to be covered it is important they contact their insurance agent. Car Insurance Policy - Bundles - Some insurance companies allow you to bundle services for a discount! If you already have coverage for a car, you can contact your agent and get quotes on adding a renter's policy to your account. Many times bundling services results in annual savings for a multiple policy account. Renter's Insurance Policy - Single: If the first two options aren't the right fit for you, there are many insurance companies that offer renter policies. A good place to start learning is to check out this article all about Renter's insurance from The Zebra and also this Forbes article about the importance of renter's insurance .

About West Campus Nord Avenue and its extension as Walnut Street form a natural "west campus" boundary for several neighborhoods west of the Union Pacific railroad tracks that have long been popular with college-aged renters. Rental prices are generally closer to north campus rates, and many businesses and services are located along Nord Avenue. Nord Avenue becomes Walnut Street, and vice versa, at West Sacramento Avenue.
The B-Line Bus, our local public bus system, provides free bus service to and from campus every 30 minutes on academic days.

Renter's Insurance Some housing providers may require renter's insurance and some may not. It is always recommended to have proper coverage in case the unexpected happens. Homeowner's Policy - Side Coverage - Some students may be covered under their parent's homeowners policy, however it is important not to just assume. If a parent wishes a student's rental to be covered it is important they contact their insurance agent. Car Insurance Policy - Bundles - Some insurance companies allow you to bundle services for a discount! If you already have coverage for a car, you can contact your agent and get quotes on adding a renter's policy to your account. Many times bundling services results in annual savings for a multiple policy account. Renter's Insurance Policy - Single: If the first two options aren't the right fit for you, there are many insurance companies that offer renter policies. A good place to start learning is to check out this article all about Renter's insurance from The Zebra and also this Forbes article about the importance of renter's insurance .

housing_summary:
接待校原文參考；適用年度及淡江提名／校區另核對：From suites to shared apartments to family housing, Student Housing offers the convenience of on-campus living plus the amenities and services that enrich the student experience.
2026-2027 Student Housing Application
If you are interested in working for the housing community, visit the Student Employment page.
The Apartments at University Park In a double with a kitchen, you share a bedroom with one other student in a two-bedroom apartment and share the common area in the apartment with two additional students occupying the second bedroom. A majority of students live in this type of housing. In a double without a kitchen, you share a bedroom with one other student in a two-bedroom apartment and share the common area in the apartment with two additional students occupying the second bedroom. This apartment has no kitchen and the purchase of a meal plan is required. Please note this choice of the room takes precedence over any and all living learning communities and roommate preferences.
Student Housing has started a waitlist for the 2026-2027 academic year. If you intend to live on campus, please log into the Student Housing Portal and add yourself to the waitlist. There is no fee to join the waitlist.
A one-time $15 optional Residence Hall Association fee is placed on all student resident accounts. The Residence Hall Association (RHA) is an organization of residents acting as agents of opportunity to promote a healthy academic and social environment while voicing the concerns of the community. RHA provides opportunities for development in leadership skills, interpersonal and intercultural growth. If you wish not to participate in this fee, you can opt-out via the Student Housing website. Students must opt-out no later than 30 days before check-in.
If a student wishes to request a cancelation of their housing contract, they must complete the "License Agreement Cancellation Form" found in the Student Housing Portal "Forms" menu. Students who do not initiate the cancellation process will remain bound by the Student Housing License Agreement and will be charged all housing fees for their assigned space during the entire contract period.
An automated email will be sent upon submission of this form. The housing application fee is non-refundable.

All requests requiring review are evaluated by the Housing Release Board, and a written decision is typically sent to the student within 10 to 15 business days after the request has been reviewed. Students who submit a request by the deadline will be assigned to a specific meeting date and notified accordingly. As part of the request, students submit a written statement and any supporting documentation in advance of the meeting. Students may choose to attend the Housing Release Board meeting to provide additional context for their request, or have their documentation reviewed without being present. During the meeting, the Board reviews requests individually. Students who attend the meeting are seen on a first-come, first-served basis based on order of arrival, with each in-person review typically lasting approximately 20 minutes.

student_guide_sections.summary:
日本とベトナムの架け橋となるような仕事をすることが夢で、今年の9月からベトナムに戻り、その第一歩となる仕事をしています。ベトナム人エンジニア（建設業界）に日本語を初級から中級まで教える仕事で、但し、日本語教師の業務だけではなく、採用の面接や会議での通訳業務も行っています。日本学・国際コミュニケーション（JIC）専攻で日本語教員養成課程を勉強し、高い日本語能力、日本語教育学や日本語教育とコミュニケーションなど、日本語を教えるのに必要な力がつき、実際に学生を指導できていることがとても嬉しいです。
一人ひとりの目的に合わせた日本語能力を育成し、​ 充実したキャンパスライフをサポートします。​
各自の目標に合わせて、日本語能力試験やBJT日本語能力テストの対策授業を受けることができます。各試験の出題形式に合わせて問題を解く練習や模擬試験で実践力を養います。​

Each year, the program offers 285 reduced-rate housing opportunities for selected students assigned to the North Village traditional residence halls (double-occupancy rooms only). The reduced rate applies to room rent only and does not include meal plan charges or any other housing-related fees.
This program is designed to help students who are entering a new lease agreement and need assistance with paying the security deposits and first month’s rent up to a maximum amount of $1500.00
The College Initiative is a partnership between Lutheran Social Services (LSS), CSUS and Sacramento County Office of Education (SCOE) serving student parents 18-24 years with dependent children, and who are housing insecure. Services include housing navigation support, rent subsidy, emergency grants, and educational and developmental support for the student parents' children. Please initiate your referral by completing the Student Parent Housing Interest Form and the Housing Navigator will contact you.
Make an appointment & arrive on time: Make sure to call ahead and schedule an appointment for a tour and stick to it. And arrive at least 10 minutes early. Promptness can be a good indicator of whether you can pay rent on time in the landlord’s eyes. Follow up: Following up can show the landlord that you are interested and remind them of who you are. Be presentable: There may be many people interested in the same complex or unit you may be interested in. Proper attire can help you stand out. Have money ready: Be prepared to put money down to hold a place if you find one that you like. However, make sure you get a receipt for the deposit and note whether it is refundable if you decide not to rent, or if the deposit will be applied toward the rent. Note: The average apartment in Sacramento starts at $1850 for a 1-bedroom apartment. Be prepared to have that along with money for a deposit, which typically equals one month’s rent. Start early: Get a jump on the search. Keep in mind that other people will be looking to rent as well so make sure to start looking early. If you are looking to rent in the fall, start looking towards the end of the spring semester.
